subject: Sprint nomination: Altair feature set (request for roadmap commit)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Altair feature set — sprint nomination

Vivek —

Quick note from the Altair deal team: Ruth from Altair confirms their board wants a hard commitment for two items before they sign the PO:

- Tenant affinity & warm-cache behavior for high-volume billing lookups (their spike on peak hours is the blocker)
- Short-term SLA for 99th percentile tail with an audit/export hook (they need export evidence for procurement)

I attached the mutual action plan and a one-pager (altair_map_v1.pdf / mutual-action-plan.xlsx). They asked if we can have a roadmap-level commit that these land in our Q4 sprint window (target go-live: mid-November).

Asking for product + eng: Is this feasible to nominate for the next two sprint cycles if we treat the tenant affinity as MVP and push tenant-isolation/long-term residency to a follow-up? Altair is asking for an explicit timeline to present to procurement by 10/08.

Key constraints from the customer:
- Peak P95/P99 must be under 350ms for their 95th percentile queries
- Exportable audit logs for a 30-day window
- No data residency change (US only)

Can you give a rough yes/no + estimated sprint effort by EOD today? If we can get product buy-in I will coordinate a short working session with Altair next week.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: altair_map_v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Altair feature set — sprint nomination

Marissa — thanks for the context and for pushing the MAP over. I skimmed the attachment; high level ask is clear and timebox is tight. A couple of clarifying questions before engineering scoping:

1) For "tenant affinity & warm-cache": do they want hard affinity (session pinned to a GPU pool) or best-effort affinity with sticky routing? The implementation cost differs substantially.
2) For the SLA export: is the requirement a continuous streaming export, or periodic batch snapshots (they mentioned procurement wants "evidence" — can you ask what format)?
3) Any regulatory redlines from procurement beyond the 30-day audit window (e.g., SOC-2 evidence needs)?

Markus / Laura — can you weigh in on feasibility? If this is nominated for Q4 we need a scoped ticket set, testing plan, and a contingency fallback for the warm-cache behavior in case we hit perf regressions. If eng can provide a ballpark sprint estimate (story points or sprints), I'll escalate to Product leadership + Karthik for prioritization.

If you prefer, we can do a 30-min quick sync today to accelerate.

—Vivek
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Altair feature set — sprint nomination

Folks — brief technical readout after a quick pass with the runtime team:

Summary (short): doable in Q4 with tradeoffs. Rough engineering ask: 2–3 sprints (4-week sprint cadence assumed) to deliver a safe MVP that covers Altair's core asks.

Details / options:
- Option A (fast): Implement sticky routing + warm cache seeding for the cohort and a lightweight affinity token. Deliverables: routing shim, cache seeding job, runtime flags, smoke tests. Estimate: 2 sprints if we can defer backward-incompatible changes and deprioritize planned infra work.
- Option B (robust): Full tenant affinity with GPU pool pinning + KV-layer persistence and stronger eviction guarantees. Estimate: 3+ sprints, needs scheduling and capacity reservation (Dedicated) and likely a small infra spend.

SLA/export work:
- We can provide periodic batch export (CSV/JSON) of audit logs and latency metrics within 30 days; streaming export will add ~0.5 sprint and require a consumer endpoint. See attached sla_sketch.png for proposed artifacts and who owns each piece.

Dependencies / blockers:
- QA needs a perf harness and a representative Altair prompt set (Marissa, can you get a sanitized sample?)
- Capacity planning: if we go Option B we need a Dedicated reserve or an allowance for burst; that'll affect cost proposals to the customer.
- Product acceptance criteria: we need explicit P95/P99 targets and pass/fail for canary.

Recommendation: Nominate Option A for a conditional roadmap commit. That gives Altair the functional behavior they need for procurement while keeping schedule risk manageable. If Product signs off, engineering will open the epic and estimate stories; we can present a concrete timeline by 10/07.

Attachments: sla_sketch.png

– Markus
Engineering Lead, Inference Runtime

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Altair feature set — sprint nomination

Thanks all — great notes. I agree with Markus' assessment and propose the following product position:

- Conditional roadmap nomination: we will commit to Option A (sticky routing + warm-cache seeding) for Q4 on the condition that Altair accepts an initial canary (limited traffic cohort) and a documented fallback behavior.
- Acceptance criteria: P95 < 200ms (core queries), P99 < 400ms for the canary cohort; batch audit export available within 30 days; perf regression threshold of no more than 5% compared to baseline.
- Timeline: open epic now; engineering to provide sprint-by-sprint milestones by 10/07; target deployment to canary by 11/10, full rollout by 11/24 contingent on canary results.

Next steps:
1) Marissa: confirm Altair can accept a canary + provide sanitized prompt sample and procurement's desired export format by 10/07.
2) Markus: open epic and rough-scope stories; share sprint plan on 10/07.
3) Vivek/Karthik: I will prepare a short executive note to legal and CS outlining the conditional nature and the rollback plan.

Marissa — please set a 30-minute working session with Altair for next week (include engineering). I will bring PRD notes and acceptance criteria to that call.
